object.name: cut
object.property: python:checkPermission("Delete objects", globals_view.getParentObject()) and checkPermission("Copy or Move", object) and not globals_view.isPortalOrPortalDefaultPage() and context.restrictedTraverse('is_moveable')()

object.name: delete
object.property: python:checkPermission("Delete objects", globals_view.getParentObject()) and not globals_view.isPortalOrPortalDefaultPage() and context.restrictedTraverse('is_deletable')()

object.name: rename
object.property: python:checkPermission("Delete objects", globals_view.getParentObject()) and checkPermission("Copy or Move", object) and checkPermission("Add portal content", object) and not globals_view.isPortalOrPortalDefaultPage() and context.restrictedTraverse('is_moveable')()
